generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPP Portal.
Contractors Should be registered with KPWD as Class-2 and Above Contractor
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents Contractors Should be registered with KPWD as Class-II and Above Contractor and further orders there on.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work.
The tenderer should maintain the Building works during the defective liability period for 1 years.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to any adjacent structures/utilities above or below the ground and also to the existing canal CD works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost. Damage to physical property and personal injury and death will be the personal risk of the contractor.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost.
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment till the completion of project.

All materials required for the work like bitumen, steel, cement etc., shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work at their own cost.

The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.6 of standard tender document Attached. For calculation of tender capacity A and B values must be furnished work wise duly signed by the authorized signatory.

All the items in the tender including all lead, lifts,loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and convence of all matiral and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detalied technical specification and direction of Engineer-in-charge of this work.

When embankments are constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing field channels, bunds and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the privaling rules of labour act & The contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009

As per the Government Circular No.PWD:ITC:2008/2099, Dated.2-12-2010, the tendered contractors, should submit the Original Bank Guarantee issued by the Bankers for the said work at the time of opening of the Technical Bids.

Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders. As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

Minimum One Lakh Rupees of the specified EMD should be paid in any one of the forms mentioned in Clause 13.1, Bank Guarantee must be given for the remaining amount in prescribed format. The copy of the Bank Guarantee must be scanned and submitted along with the Technical bid. The original should be produced during opening of Technical bid
The successful tenderer should provide monthly physical and financial progress to be achieved in Bar chart/Milestone chart/PERT chart during agreement.
The returns submitted to the I.T. along with the Profit and Loss account statement,Balance sheet should be uploaded for the financial turnover criteria attested by registered Chartered Accountant.

The tenderer who quotes amount less than amount put to tender should pay difference amount in the form of FDR purchased through any nationalized / scheduled bank payable in favor The Executive Engineer at the time of execution of the tender agreement.
Note:- If any postponement of receipt date of tender, the same will be published in the KPPP portal.

All the originals of uploaded documents in KPP-portal should be produced within 7 working days from the date of opening of Technical Bid at the Division Office, failing which the tender is liable for rejection. No separate communication will be made in this regard, failing which action will be taken as per tender conditions and registration rules.
Contractor should establish a fully functional laboratory at site at no extra cost in order to carry out all the required tests for the materials being used in the project.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum. the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost
LOC / K-form for the stipulated amount should be submitted in the format as prescribed in the bid document

For the vehicles/machinaries/ equipments for which RTO registration is statutory,for such vehicles/machinaries / equipments the contractor should upload the Registration Certificate documents issued by RTO. For machinaries and other equipments for which RTO registration is not applicable, for such machinaries and equipments, purchase invoice document should be uploaded. If there is sale deed for such machinaries and equipments, original invoice along with registered sale deed should be uploaded.

Contractor should adhere to HSE policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.
Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Division, Tumkur during office hours on all working days.
